precepts.text: In Judah is God known. That's why Christ came out of Judah. Salvation comes from Judah. He ain't tribe hopping.
precepts.point: The Lord God hath sworn by himself, I abhor the excellency of Jacob: because all 12 tribes was going off. Therefore will I deliver up the city with all that is therein. So the southern kingdom was going to get it, and the northern kingdom.

note.label: Raising Up the Tabernacle of David That Fell

precepts.why:
“In Judah is God known: his name is great in Israel.” Christ told the Samaritan woman “salvation is of the Jews”, and the psalm agrees: in Judah is God known.

That is why Christ came out of Judah. Salvation comes from Judah. He is not tribe hopping.

So when Amos speaks against those at ease in Zion and those who trust in the mountain of Samaria, the difference between the two is not that one of them was righteous; all twelve went off and both would go captive. But God was known in Judah, and out of Judah the salvation of all Israel would come.

precepts.text: The Lord appointed a set time, and on the morrow all the cattle of Egypt died, but of the cattle of the children of Israel not one died. He touches the nations but spares His people.
precepts.point: When it says the remainder of wrath He shall restrain, it means He is not going to destroy everything and everybody like He did in the flood, where even then eight remained. When the Lord touches up on something, He touches up on him.

note.label: Psalm 76: God Is Known in Judah and Terrible to the Kings of the Earth

precepts.why:
“Surely the wrath of man shall praise thee: the remainder of wrath shalt thou restrain.” When we see the Lord put in his judgment upon the earth, everybody will know that the Most High did it. And the remainder of wrath he shall restrain means he is not going to destroy everything and everybody like he did in the flood, where even then eight remained.

Egypt shows how he does it. “And the Lord appointed a set time, saying, To morrow the Lord shall do this thing in the land. And the Lord did that thing on the morrow, and all the cattle of Egypt died: but of the cattle of the children of Israel died not one.”

He appointed a set time, and on the morrow all the cattle of Egypt died, but of the cattle of the children of Israel not one died. He touches the nations but spares his people. When the Lord touches up on something, he touches up on him. That is the wrath that praises him and the remainder that is restrained.

points: In Judah is God known, His name is great in Israel. In Salem is His tabernacle and in Zion His dwelling place. There He broke the arrows of the bow, the shield, the sword, and the battle.

note.label: Psalm 76: God Is Known in Judah and Terrible to the Kings of the Earth

points: The Most High is more glorious and excellent than the mountains of prey. The stouthearted are spoiled, they have slept their sleep, and none of the men of might found their hands. At His rebuke both the chariot and horse are cast into a dead sleep.

note.label: Psalm 76: God Is Known in Judah and Terrible to the Kings of the Earth

points: The Most High alone is to be feared, and none may stand in His sight when He is angry. He caused judgment to be heard from heaven, and the earth feared and was still when God arose to save all the meek of the earth.

note.label: Psalm 76: God Is Known in Judah and Terrible to the Kings of the Earth

points: When we see the Lord put in His judgment upon the earth, everybody will know that the Most High did it. The wrath of man shall praise Him.

When it says the remainder of wrath He shall restrain, it means He is not going to destroy everything and everybody like He did in the flood, where even then eight remained. When the Lord touches up on something, He touches up on him.

note.label: Psalm 76: God Is Known in Judah and Terrible to the Kings of the Earth

points: Vow and pay unto the Lord your God; let all that are round about Him bring presents unto Him that ought to be feared. He shall cut off the spirit of princes and is terrible to the kings of the earth.
